news.body:
## Your first coaching session is tomorrow
- Wednesday at 10:00 CET, which is half past two your time.
Liesbeth already has your CV and your Career Plan workbook, so the hour is all yours. The only two career things open on your board are the Bain fellowship, which closes on Sunday, and the Harver assessment - both worth putting to her rather than deciding on your own.
## Today is the instalment date
- The wire left SBI on the 19th and nothing has confirmed it arrived.
Marie Rose asked to be kept posted, and today is the date she would be checking against. - One line to her saying the transfer has gone closes this properly.
